newsitem.title: USA: Strober says unsolicited bid withdrawn.
newsitem.headline: Strober says unsolicited bid withdrawn.

text.p: Strober Organization Inc said Wednesday that an unsolicited offer from a third party to acquire the company for $6.50 per share, or about $35 million, has been withdrawn.
The company said the offer was withdrawn on Tuesday, six days after it was submitted, because financing for the undisclosed third party was not "forthcoming."

Strober said an earlier merger agreement with a private venture capital investor group for $6.00 per share, or $32 million, remains in place. The company said it expects the transaction to be completed around January or February of 1997. Strober supplies building materials to contractors.
